title: EM-based iterations for multiple instance learning on a query-value model
summary: In multiple instance regression (MIR) data are organized into bags (collections of instances in feature space) and the goal is to learn a mapping that assigns labels to bags. A typical assumption is that there is a so-called concept point in feature space, the proximity to which dictates the bag label. Motivated by modern MIR architectures which are based on attention, we study a softmax model that decouples the concept point and the labeling scheme.
